_note: All text players see for rp_crews. Edit the words on the right side only. Keep every %s: the game fills those in.
title: Crew

tip.solo: Working alone? Crews pay more: +%s%% for each crewmate on the same job, up to +%s%%. Type /crew to start one.
tip.new_job: New job: %s. Tip: crews pay more (+%s%% per crewmate on the same job, up to +%s%%). Stand next to a friend and type /crew to invite them.

crew.you_joined: You joined the crew. Each task pays +%s%% for every crewmate working the same job (up to +%s%%). Type /crew to see who's in it.
crew.you_were_removed: You were removed from the crew.
crew.disbanded: Your crew broke up (it takes at least 2).

menu.how_desc: Everyone runs their own route. Each task pays +%s%% for every crewmate who's also working the same job right now (up to +%s%%). Up to %s people.
menu.invite_by_id_desc: Their ID is next to their name on the scoreboard (player list).
menu.id_desc: The number next to their name in the player list
menu.nobody_nearby_desc: Stand next to them, or invite by ID instead.
menu.remove_text: %s will be taken out of the crew.

invite.text:
**%s** (%s) wants you in their crew.

Everyone still runs their own route, but each task pays **+%s%%** for every crewmate working the same job (up to **+%s%%**).

command.crew_help: Open your crew menu, or invite someone: /crew [their ID]
